jobCosts.title: Job costs: {reference}
jobCosts.sources: This report shows job costs, not revenue or money received. Estimated: the internal material and labor costs of the approved estimate's lines. Actual: the cost entries recorded here (voided entries left out) and each worker's Arrived-to-Finished time on the job's own visits. Return work is shown apart; invoices, payments and deposits are not part of it.
jobCosts.neverZero: A cost that is not known shows as not recorded, not estimated or not configured, never as $0.00. An amount is final only once the Owner confirms its category; until then it is the part known so far.
jobCosts.noEstimate: No approved estimate version: nothing is estimated.

dashboard.sources: Recorded data only. Invoiced amounts are not money received, and the deposit is counted once, on the final invoice.
